requirements.requirement: Application describes the forms of Internet-based TRS to be provided.
Application describes in detail how all applicable non-waived mandatory minimum standards will be met and includes documentary or other evidence.
VRS application includes required call-center facility and technology/equipment ownership, lease, license, and ACD evidence as applicable.
Application includes qualifying ownership/control interests, organization/executives, TRS employee counts, retained employment agreements, and sponsorship arrangements.
Application states that annual compliance reports will be filed.
Certification application includes a qualifying senior-executive certification with first-hand knowledge under penalty of perjury.
Applicant consents to Commission on-site visits used to assess the application.
Initial VRS applicants seeking at-home call handling include a detailed 64.604(d)(7) compliance plan.
Internet-based TRS certification and Fund eligibility arise only after Commission review and determination that the documentation establishes the required standards and compliance procedures.
Internet-based TRS certification lasts five years and renewal documentation is filed at least 90 days before expiration.
Certified VRS/IP Relay providers notify the Commission of substantive service/program/feature changes within 60 days and certify continued minimum-standard compliance.
Annual report updates certification information/documentation or certifies no changes and includes qualifying senior-executive certification.

Each VRS annual report includes a 64.604(c)(13) compliance plan with responsible management, training, reporting mechanisms, internal audits, and waste/fraud/abuse prevention policies; failure to file removes compensation entitlement during noncompliance.

If the Commission finds a compliance plan inadequate, the provider must correct and submit an amended plan within the directed period not exceeding 60 days; failure removes compensation entitlement during noncompliance.
